title: features-report/1: what `mzlab-cli features` did by itself on a series, written at `--report PATH`
description: The recipe line, one entry per input member (unit resolution, profile share, whether its profile scans were centroided, the channel defect, the m/z shift measured against the series and whether it was subtracted, the features detected), the rows merged as duplicates and every automatic choice with its reason. stdout (the CSV) is the same with or without `--report`. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/features_report.rs, crates/mzlab-feat/src/lrscreen*.rs.

recipe.description: the recipe of the series in one line, the same words as the plan

member.description: the path as given, or FILE@ID for a sample selected with --sample

column.description: the label of the column of the table, the sample name (with the extension of its file; NAME (FILE #ID) when two names collide); present only for a sample selected with --sample

profile_fraction.description: share of the MS1 scans in profile mode

centroided.description: the profile scans were centroided before detection

defect.description: channel centre offset, Da (0 on the ppm axis)

mz_shift_da.description: m/z shift of the file against the series, Da; 0 when it was not measured

recentred.description: the shift was subtracted (it is at least 0.05 Da)

rows.description: features detected in the file, before the alignment

mz_offset_da.description: the m/z offset subtracted from the file before the grouping (--mz-offset), Da, observed - true; present only with --mz-offset

mz_offset.description: mode fixed, or auto with ion_mz, rt_min, status (ok, wide, not_found), n_scans, apex_rt_min, apex_intensity, spread_da, snr (as in trace/1)

merged.description: rows dropped as the same ion as a taller row (`dedup`)

r.description: Pearson r of the area vectors of the two rows (null below 3 common files)

rule.description: the rule that merged them: r at or above `threshold`, or the peak overlap at or above `threshold` (`dedup_overlap` 0 in `--params`, or `--set gapfill1.dedup_overlap=0` in a Flow plan, turns the second off; it also needs the wider peak covered by half of it, in 2 files or the only file)

overlap.description: median share of the narrower peak the two rows cover, over the files where both were detected (null: none)

overlap_wide.description: the same median for the wider peak; the overlap rule needs half of `threshold` (null: none)

shared_files.description: files where both rows have a detected peak (rule overlap) or an area (rule correlation)

threshold.description: threshold of the rule that decided

height_kept.description: highest cell height of the kept row

height_dropped.description: highest cell height of the dropped row

near_total.description: all pairs of rows still within 0.6 Da and the RT tolerance that no rule merged; `near` lists the first 20

near.description: pairs of rows still within 0.6 Da and the RT tolerance that no rule merged, in m/z order, up to 20: they may be different ions; the numbers to read before setting `dedup_overlap`
